Model-guard structure adapted for C-only identity, required controller selection and exact current source inventories

limits: Input provenance only; native builds and software tests are reported independently in standalone-validation.json. C physical flashing, recovery, OLED, heating/pump/RFID and brewing acceptance are unperformed. No safe in-place installer or qualified C USB installation flow exists in this revision; firmware_update is false.
ui_adaptation: All C UI source/layouts were preserved. Standalone service/cancellation/local-store changes were then adapted per function; no S/Pro UI layout replacement.
operation_scope: Each operation records the initial input or adaptation stage. Preserved base describes the input copy, not a claim that the final modified file is byte-identical. Current application hashes are in the per-variant firmware reports.
standalone_adaptation: The frozen C controller, RFID, plumbing, display assets and layouts remain the hardware/application base. Shared local HTTP/API, recipes, history, telemetry and standalone SDK deltas were adapted from the current S/Pro implementation. C menu wake-up, scrolling, cancellation and display geometry use explicit C contracts.
